description: Developed a full-featured laundry management web application with real-time order tracking, secure payments, and dynamic dashboards.
Built responsive, mobile-friendly UI using React and Tailwind CSS for seamless user experience.
Integrated RESTful APIs, optimizing page speed by 20% for faster load times.
Designed scalable MongoDB schemas to manage users, orders, and payments efficiently.
Implemented JWT-based authentication for secure user sessions and initiated planning for real-time notifications.
Built and enhanced frontend features for a fintech platform supporting rural farmers with intuitive, user-friendly design.
Designed interactive dashboards for loan management and payment tracking, improving user accessibility and engagement.
Integrated Graph.js for visualizing real-time financial data, providing actionable insights for farmers and stakeholders.
Developed downloadable PDF invoices, enabling farmers to manage offline records and ensure better financial transparency.
Added PWA features, enabling offline mode and seamless home screen installation for improved accessibility in low-network areas.
